name: Christmas Eve New England Clam Chowder or Creamy Potato Soup in a Sourdough Bread Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Home Cooking & Local Bakery Cafés (Christmas Eve)
whyItWorks: A classic Utah Christmas Eve tradition: tender diced potatoes, minced clams, and warm soup-soaked sourdough bread interior are low in roughage and comforting on a cold night when paired with lactase.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Take 1–2 lactase enzyme tablets before eating (or make at home with lactose-free half-and-half) and eat the soft soup-soaked sourdough interior while leaving the tough outer bread crust.
watchOuts: High lactose and butterfat in traditional cream chowder—always use lactase enzymes
